messages:
zoe (product): Quick thread to decide the 'privileged view' UX for API secrets. Need final copy, permission gating behavior, download pattern, and audit link placement. Code freeze in 2 days.

harper (design): Recap of proposed flow: after Create -> show inline secret card + short banner 'This is the only time you'll see the secret.' Primary action 'Copy', secondary 'Download .env'. For users without Key Manager role, hide the secret and show a permissive CTA 'Request access'.

kai (devex): Implementation notes: we'll generate the .env via JS Blob at creation time (no secret in href). For users who request access, trigger a lightweight request with prefilled org and role, not a full invite flow. Keep copy short.

morgan (eng): Backend constraints: we must never log raw secret; also we can emit an audit event for 'secret created' and optionally include actor id + key id (no secret). For gated view, server should check role on every view, not just client-side.

riley (a11y): Accessibility: If secret is hidden due to permissions, present the 'Request access' button as a visible focusable control and announce via aria-live when the request completes: 'Access request submitted to workspace admins.' For the inline secret card, after creation move focus to it and announce 'Secret available for copying'. Copy button aria-label must include 'will not be shown again'.

harper (design): Copy suggestion for request flow: Button text 'Request Key Manager access' and dialog text: 'Workspace admins can grant view permission. We'll notify them on your behalf.' Keep the dialog minimal; include a link 'Who are admins?' that opens team settings.

zoe (product): Good. Also want an explicit 'View audit log' link on the key row (small text) so admins can see past actions without leaving the page. Audit link should open in a new tab.

morgan (eng): We'll add audit_link attribute from API. Important: the audit endpoint requires admin scope; if user lacks it, show the link disabled with tooltip 'Insufficient permissions'.

kai (devex): For download .env, default to prefilled vars:

REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk_live_xxx
REDWOOD_REGION=us-east-1
REDWOOD_API_URL=https://api.redwood.ai

and include a small toggle 'Include usage example' that adds a curl snippet. We'll generate blob after creation and revoke it from memory on navigation.

riley (a11y): Keyboard considerations: after Create, user can press Tab to Copy then Shift+Tab returns to Close. If user can't view secret, pressing Request should open the dialog and focus first interactive element. Also ensure color contrast for the inline banner >= 4.5:1.

harper (design): UI nit: show a small lock badge on rows where viewing is restricted. Tooltip: 'Hidden secret  requires Key Manager role to view'. Maybe shorten copy in tooltip.

zoe (product): Revocation UX: immediate revoke + 20s undo snackbar. For keys that were viewed by requestors, add a short blurb in the revoke confirmation: 'This may break apps using the key. Audit logs will show usage.'

morgan (eng): We'll flip revoked flag immediately. Undo will call a re-enable endpoint with same checks. Audit event emitted on revoke and restore.

kai (devex): Security note: avoid placing the secret in any data-attributes or accessible attributes. Clipboard copy should be handled via secure execCommand or navigator.clipboard when available.

riley (a11y): Final a11y checklist requested: aria-live for create, focus management for dialogs, role=alertdialog for revoke confirm, visible focus rings for all CTA, accessible labels for copy/download, disabled link behavior for audit link. I'll produce snippets.

zoe (product): Action items: harper -> updated mock with locked rows + request dialog; morgan -> API changes for audit_link + server-side view gating; kai -> doc for download-blob & memory clearing; riley -> ARIA snippet doc. I'll track and merge before freeze.
audit-bot: Audit event emitted: branch "feature/privileged-key-view" staged to integration at 2026-03-23T16:45:00Z

zoe (product): Thanks team!
